content: Good. Now I have a full picture. Let me create the professional integrated dashboard — combining the best of both Streamlit and Dash code into one polished `dashboard.py`:

ArtifactMetadata.Summary:
Professional NEXUS War Room dashboard rewrite with:
- Full dark cyber theme with gradient headers, glowing metric cards, animated badges
- Consistent NEXUS_LAYOUT applied to all Plotly charts (dark background, cyan grid)
- Live battle progress bar and winner timeline strip
- Styled event feed with color-coded lines (battle/attack/detect)
- SOAR tab with stacked area timeline + donut-style metric breakdown
- ATT&CK tab with tactic coverage donut chart and color-coded evasion rates
- Export tab with icon cards, file timestamps, and binary-safe download
- Provider selector with emoji labels
- System health sidebar with DB size and timestamp
- All encoding issues fixed (utf-8 + errors=replace for text, read_bytes for binary)

args.Description: Full professional NEXUS War Room dashboard with dark cyber theme, animated KPIs, live feed, all tabs polished, proper encoding fixes, and enhanced visuals.
